passes.name: Double Cash
passes.description: Doubles your income for good, in every era.

passes.name: Offline Pro
passes.description: While you are away, earn for up to 24 hours instead of 8, at full rate instead of half.

passes.name: VIP
passes.description: +10% income, a VIP name tag, a gold plot sign, and an alternate building skin set in every era.

products.name: 30 Minutes of Cash
products.description: Cash worth up to 30 minutes of your current income. Capped at a tenth of the current era, so it speeds you up rather than finishing the era.

products.name: 2 Hours of Cash
products.description: Cash worth up to 2 hours of your current income. Capped at a quarter of the current era, so it speeds you up rather than finishing the era.

products.name: 8 Hours of Cash
products.description: Cash worth up to 8 hours of your current income. Capped at half of the current era, so it speeds you up rather than finishing the era.

products.name: Double it
products.description: Doubles the cash you just earned while away. Offered once, on the welcome-back card.
